crossRefs.note: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the…
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why…
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

translations.web: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
translations.bsb: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
translations.kjv: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face
translations.asv: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?
